mapper.select: SELECT si.item_id, si.batch_id, si.result, si.processed_at, si.failure_code, si.failure_message, ke.exchange_id, ke.account_id, ke.order_id, ke.provisional_amount, ke.provisional_at, ke.settlement_status, so.settlement_fx_rate, so.status AS sell_order_status, ind.purchase_currency FROM settlement_item si INNER JOIN krw_exchange ke ON ke.exchange_id = si.exchange_id INNER JOIN sell_order so ON so.order_id = ke.order_id INNER JOIN inbound_detail ind ON ind.inbound_detail_id = so.inbound_detail_id WHERE si.batch_id = #{batchId} AND si.item_id = #{itemId} AND si.result IS NULL AND so.status = 'EXECUTED'
